heading: Advancing IoT for Precision Agriculture Capabilities Act

tree.heading: Short title
tree.text: This section may be cited as the “Advancing IoT for Precision Agriculture Act of 2021”.

tree.heading: Purpose
tree.text: It is the purpose of this section to promote scientific research and development opportunities for connected technologies that advance precision agriculture capabilities.

tree.heading: Foundation directive on agricultural sensor research
tree.text: In making awards under the sensor systems and networked systems programs of the Foundation, the Director shall include in consideration of portfolio balance research and development on sensor connectivity in environments of intermittent connectivity and intermittent computation—

children.text: to improve the reliable use of advance sensing systems in rural and agricultural areas; and
direct gateway access for locally stored data;

tree.heading: GAO review
tree.text: Not later than 18 months after August 9, 2022, the Comptroller General of the United States shall provide—

children.text: a technology assessment of precision agriculture technologies, such as the existing use of—
sensors, scanners, radio-frequency identification, and related technologies that can monitor soil properties, irrigation conditions, and plant physiology;
sensors, scanners, radio-frequency identification, and related technologies that can monitor livestock activity and health;
network connectivity and wireless communications that can securely support digital agriculture technologies in rural and remote areas;
aerial imagery generated by satellites or unmanned aerial vehicles;
control systems design and connectivity, such as smart irrigation control systems;
data management software and advanced analytics that can assist decision making and improve agricultural outcomes; and
a review of Federal programs that provide support for precision agriculture research, development, adoption, education, or training, in existence on August 9, 2022.

notes.text: Codification Section is comprised of section 10361 of Pub. L. 117–167. Subsec. (d) of section 10361 of Pub. L. 117–167 amended section 1862i of this title.
